items.t: Hood can pop open while driving
items.job: Inspect and replace hood latch
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel filler neck can be damaged by a failed tire
items.job: Install fuel filler neck protective shield
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. A damaged filler neck costs more to replace.

items.t: Four-speed automatic shifts harshly or slips
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a rebuilt or new unit
items.note: KBB 2003 Jetta dealer range: parts $5,009–$5,373, labor $1,661–$1,799. Owners report about $1,800 with a rebuilt unit and $3,200 shop quotes; CarComplaints typical $3,350. Have the fluid level and codes checked first; a fluid or software fix sometimes helps.

items.t: Window drops into the door
items.job: Replace window regulator (one door)
items.note: Based on estimators; no parts-plus-labor source found. RepairPal: $310–$443 total for 1999–2004 ($395–$527 for 2005); YourMechanic: about $281 for a 2003.

items.t: Brake lights may not work correctly
items.job: Replace brake light switch with redesigned part
items.note: Several recalls cover these years. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Turn signals work only some of the time
items.job: Replace hazard switch and turn signal relay
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: ABS control unit fire risk
items.job: Replace ABS control unit
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Ignition coil failures
items.job: Replace one ignition coil
items.note: Based on RepairPal: $171–$229 average for a Jetta coil replacement; no parts-plus-labor source found. Replacing all four coils costs more.

items.t: Fuel leak in the engine bay
items.job: Repair leaking fuel line, clamp or pump seal
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Camshaft wear on the diesel
items.job: Replace camshaft and lifters (cylinder head off)
items.note: Parts: BRM camshaft kit (cam, lifters, bearings, seal) is $550 at Parts Place; a head gasket, head bolts and timing belt kit add to that. No book labor time found; hours are set from owner-reported totals. CarComplaints owners report $3,500–$8,053 (typical $4,780). Cost rises if metal debris damaged other engine parts.

items.t: Fuel line can chafe and leak
items.job: Inspect and replace chafed fuel line
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Driveshaft cover screws can loosen
items.job: Replace driveshaft (axle) mounting screws
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Cost rises if the axle was damaged.

items.t: DSG automatic jerks or loses drive
items.job: Replace or rebuild DSG mechatronic unit
items.note: Ask the dealer about software updates and recalls first. A full transmission costs much more.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner (often with chain and guides)
items.note: Based on RepairPal: $527–$757 for a 2009 and $1,288–$1,709 for 2014–2015; no parts-plus-labor source found. If the chain has already jumped, engine damage costs much more.

items.t: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump failure
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and contaminated fuel system parts
items.note: Based on owner-reported dealer bills; no parts-plus-labor source found. CarComplaints typical $7,130 (one invoice just over $9,200); dealers quoted $8,000–$10,000. Ask VW about goodwill help before paying.

items.t: Diesel injector fuel line can crack
items.job: Replace injector fuel line and add dampers
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Diesel emissions fix and settlement
items.job: Approved emissions modification under the VW diesel settlement
items.note: The approved emissions fix is done free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN for open campaigns.

items.t: ABS control unit failure
items.job: Replace ABS control module
items.note: Based on RepairPal: about $1,090–$1,191 for a 2009 Jetta; no parts-plus-labor source found. Rebuilding the old module is sometimes cheaper.

items.t: Blown fuse can shut off engine and lights
items.job: Rewire fuse layout per recall
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag warning light from clock spring
items.job: Replace steering wheel clock spring
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear trailing arm can crack after a crash
items.job: Install trailing arm reinforcement or replace arm
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. A crash-damaged arm may not be covered.

items.t: Key can come out when not in Park
items.job: Install added shifter switch and circuit board
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Transmission cooler seals may leak
items.job: Replace transmission oil cooler seals
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel rail cap may leak
items.job: Replace fuel rail
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leaks
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly, refill coolant
items.note: KBB 2016 Jetta dealer range: parts $479–$529, labor $584–$646. RepairPal: $1,117–$1,635 total for 2014–2018.

items.t: Low beams may turn off with high beams
items.job: Update headlight control software
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Loss of power brake assist
items.job: Update engine control software
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel rail bolts may loosen
items.job: Replace fuel rail bolts (and rail if needed)
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Engine block casting defect
items.job: Replace engine block or engine assembly
items.note: VW offered a buyback or new engine under the recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rear coil springs may break
items.job: Replace rear coil springs (pair)
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Ignition switch may fail in hot weather
items.job: Replace ignition switch
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: GLI fuel suction pump seal leak
items.job: Replace fuel tank suction jet pump
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Tire pressure warning may not alert
items.job: Update tire pressure monitor software
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front seat frame welds may be weak
items.job: Inspect and replace front seatback frames
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Airbag control module mounted wrong
items.job: Replace airbag control module
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera screen goes black or freezes
items.job: Update infotainment software
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Instrument panel may go blank
items.job: Update cluster software or replace instrument panel
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Loose transmission ground wire fire risk
items.job: Inspect and repair transmission ground wire
items.note: Recall repair is free at a VW dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Rough running and misfire codes after a cold start
items.job: Diagnose misfire, fuel system cleaning, spark plugs and one coil
items.note: Bulletin starts with a fuel additive and deposit cleaning; plugs or a coil only if testing points there.
